newsitem.title: USA: Federal Signal to buy Pauluhn Electric.
newsitem.headline: Federal Signal to buy Pauluhn Electric.

text.p: Federal Signal Corp said Tuesday it agreed to purchase Pauluhn Electric Manufacturing Co for an undisclosed amount.
Houston-based Pauluhn, with $17 million in annual revenue, makes and markets explosion-proof electrical products for use in hazardous areas.
Federal Signal said it expected to receive government approval for the deal within 30 days.

"Pauluhn is a strong complement to Victor Industries, Federal Signal's United Kingdom-based subsidiary, acquired in May 1996, and the industrial business of Signal Products Division. Federal Signal plans to strategically increase Pauluhn's distribution in North America," said Joseph Ross, chairman and chief executive, in a statement.
